pr_title: Fix illegal access on PIT creation for frozen index

issue_context.title: PIT creation on frozen-tier searchable snapshot indices causes a fatal error
issue_context.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): v7.13.0

**Plugins installed**: N/A

**JVM version** (`java -version`): 11, 15, 16, probably others

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system): Linux, MacOS

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

Attempting to create a PIT searcher via `POST /$INDEX/_pit?keep_alive=1m` on a `shared_cache` searchable snapshot index will cause the node to exit with a `java.lang.IllegalAccessError`.

**Steps to reproduce**:

1. Mount a searchable snapshot index with `?storage=shared_cache`
2. Execute `POST /$INDEX/_pit?keep_alive=1m`
